channel.name: Signals Music Studio
channel.about: Helping people write more music. Theory, scales, modes, chords, songwriting, song analysis. Guitar-focused but the techniques are instrument-agnostic.

series.title: New To Music Theory? Start Here!
series.goal: Intervals, scale degrees, triad construction — required before the other series.

series.title: How to Write Chord Progressions
series.goal: Diatonic major/minor loops → inversions → 7ths → secondary dominants → diminished → borrowed chords.

series.title: Understanding The Modes
series.goal: Parallel first, then relative, then one-shape guitar, then write in each mode.

series.title: Perfect Progressions
series.goal: Steal harmonic moves from real songs (Imagine, Something, Wonderful World, Champions, etc.).

series.title: Riffing With Modes
series.goal: Write a whole song/section in each major-scale mode (rock/prog/metal focus).

series.title: Jam Along and Improvise
series.goal: Improvise over labeled jam tracks (scale + chords on screen).

series.title: Exploring Harmonic Minor
series.goal: Leads, chords, writing, all 7 modes, Phrygian Dominant.

extra_youtube.title: 43 Music Theory Concepts That EVERY Modern Composer Should Master [The Music Theory Map]
extra_youtube.use: Big-picture map of theory topics; use as a syllabus index, not a first lesson.
